svg.title: Acquire Rights, Lock Inventory, Collect Settled Cash
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-controlled-ticket-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: Acquire Rights, Lock Inventory, Collect Settled Cash; subtitle: Three brokerage models share controls, not capital or payout profiles.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The core pod is one full-time operator plus two contractors. Multi-exchange resale, suite seat-splitting, and tentpole hospitality must have separate inventory, obligation, and settlement ledgers. This is event-rights brokerage, not wholesale electronics buying.; caption: A confirmed sale does not release working capital. Track transfer acceptance, event completion, refund exposure, and actual payout before replenishing inventory.; stages: label: Verify acquisition rights; value: Document source and permitted resale; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record seller identity, acquisition evidence, event, seat identifiers, transfer restrictions, and written authority. Apply 15 U.S.C. §45c; never bypass queues, purchase limits enforced by covered controls, or ticketing security measures.; label: Separate deal structures; value: Assign one of three ledgers; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Exchange resale funds individual tickets before payout; suite splitting commits a suite minimum before seats sell; tentpole packages combine ticket allotments with distinct service deposits. Require venue subdivision permission and supplier-specific cancellation terms.; label: Publish locked inventory; value: One authoritative inventory record; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Configure SkyBox, Automatiq, or Logitix for supported StubHub, Vivid Seats, SeatGeek, and TickPick connections. Test reservation propagation and automatic holds; suspend affected listings when acknowledgments lag. Never assume cross-exchange synchronization is inherently atomic.; label: Transfer verified entitlements; value: Reconcile ticket and service delivery; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Capture accepted barcode transfers, named hospitality entitlements, suite access credentials, and B2B invoice matches. Price with mandatory charges included where required; preserve the buyer-facing offer and delivery trail.; label: Release settled proceeds; value: Reconcile event-level cash and profit; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match exchange statements and corporate receipts to each sale. Deduct acquisition, sell fees, markdown losses, clawback provisions, operating costs, and funding expense. Keep cash reserved until the applicable refund and post-event settlement obligations are covered.
